name: Dokan Kits
author: Tanvir Hasan

sections.description:
Dokan Kits is the essential enhancement plugin for Dokan and Dokan Pro WooCommerce multivendor marketplaces. If you search for Dokan Kits, Dokan vendor tools, or a Dokan product video gallery, this is the plugin marketplace owners install to customize vendors, products, orders, shipping—and grow with premium Dokan Kits add-ons.

Looking for Vendor Product Video Gallery for Dokan? Dokan Kits is the free base plugin that unlocks that popular add-on so every vendor can add product videos (YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted) and sell more.

Why store owners choose Dokan Kits

  • Built only for Dokan Lite and Dokan Pro multivendor marketplaces
  • Free modular controls for vendors, products, cart, checkout, and shipping
  • Premium Dokan Kits add-ons—led by Vendor Product Video Gallery
  • Lightweight settings dashboard: enable only what your marketplace needs
  • Compatible with current WordPress, WooCommerce, and Dokan releases

Featured: Vendor Product Video Gallery for Dokan

Vendor Product Video Gallery is the top-selling Dokan Kits add-on. Give vendors a real product video gallery on Dokan product pages so shoppers see demos, unboxings, and walkthroughs—not just still photos.

  • Self-hosted product video uploads for Dokan vendors
  • YouTube and Vimeo embed support
  • Customizable video player on product pages
  • Drag-and-drop uploads with video preview
  • File size limits and REST API integration

Install Dokan Kits, then get Vendor Product Video Gallery to turn your Dokan marketplace into a video-ready storefront.

Free Features

✅ Vendor Management

  • Registration control and customization
  • Become vendor button visibility control
  • Self-purchase permission settings
  • Vendor dashboard customization
  • Default seller role assignment
  • Dokan 5 compatible vendor capability controls

✅ Product Management

  • Product type control (Variable, External, Grouped)
  • Field visibility controls
  • Add to cart button customization
  • Direct product publishing workflow control
  • Advanced feature restrictions

✅ Order & Cart Management

  • Auto-complete digital orders
  • Cart button customization
  • Checkout optimization

✅ Shipping Controls

  • Split shipping management
  • Shipping calculation optimization

🚀 Premium Add-ons for Dokan

💎 Vendor Product Video Gallery — most popular

  • ✅ Self-hosted video uploads
  • ✅ YouTube & Vimeo embedding
  • ✅ Customizable video player
  • ✅ Drag-and-drop uploads
  • ✅ Video preview functionality
  • ✅ File size restrictions
  • ✅ REST API integration

📸 Vendor Product Image Upload Limit

  • ✅ Enforce exact image dimensions
  • ✅ Set maximum file size limits
  • ✅ Restrict number of images per product
  • ✅ Client & server-side validation
  • ✅ Vendor requirement notices

🎁 Vendor Product Bundles

  • ✅ Flexible product bundling
  • ✅ Dynamic pricing options
  • ✅ Intelligent stock management
  • ✅ Multiple bundle types
  • ✅ Percentage & fixed discounts

💰 Vendor Smart Coupons Display

  • ✅ Display existing vendor coupons on product and cart pages
  • ✅ One-click coupon application with real-time feedback
  • ✅ Multiple layout options (list, checkbox, grid views)
  • ✅ Smart filtering of applied and expired coupons
  • ✅ REST API for retrieving vendor coupons
  • ✅ Template override system for customization

🛍️ Product Catalog Mode

  • ✅ Admin-managed product catalog flow for Dokan stores
  • ✅ Marketplace browsing without immediate checkout
  • ✅ Better catalog control for wholesale and inquiry-driven stores

🗂️ Vendor Media Manager

  • ✅ Dedicated media management screen for vendors
  • ✅ Faster image selection and reuse in vendor workflow
  • ✅ Cleaner product media handling for growing marketplaces

📋 Dokan Kits Vendor Audit Log

  • ✅ Central audit log for products, profiles, payouts, and withdrawals
  • ✅ Filters by date, vendor, user, action, and object type
  • ✅ Old → new value diffs with optional IP logging
  • ✅ CSV export, retention controls, and optional vendor “My Activity” page
  • ✅ Email alerts for significant price drops and payout changes

⚡ Dokan Kits Vendor Flash Sales & Countdown

  • ✅ Let vendors schedule product, category, or store-wide flash sales
  • ✅ Show live countdown banners on vendor stores and product pages
  • ✅ Support percentage, fixed-price, and BOGO promotions
  • ✅ Run marketplace mega sales with admin moderation and reporting
  • ✅ Add affiliate tracking and optional recent-sale notifications
sections.installation:
Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4.2 or higher
  • WooCommerce 9.8 or higher
  • Dokan Lite 5.0.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher (8.0+ recommended)

How to Install

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dokan-kits directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to the Dokan Kits menu in your WordPress admin to configure settings
  4. For product videos, install the Vendor Product Video Gallery add-on
sections.faq:
What is Dokan Kits?

Dokan Kits is a free toolkit plugin for Dokan and Dokan Pro multivendor marketplaces. It adds vendor, product, cart, and shipping controls, and is the base plugin for premium Dokan Kits add-ons such as Vendor Product Video Gallery.

Does Dokan Kits include a product video gallery?

Vendor Product Video Gallery is a premium Dokan Kits add-on. Install free Dokan Kits first, then get the Video Gallery add-on to let vendors upload or embed product videos on Dokan product pages.

Is Dokan Kits compatible with Dokan Pro?

Yes, Dokan Kits is compatible with both Dokan Lite and Dokan Pro. Several feature controls are designed specifically for Dokan Pro modules.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No, Dokan Kits is built with performance in mind. It uses modern development practices and only loads resources when needed.

Can I control which features to enable?

Yes, all features in Dokan Kits can be individually enabled or disabled according to your specific needs.

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Yes, Dokan Kits is fully translatable. You can translate it into your language using standard WordPress translation tools.

Does it work with custom Dokan themes?

Yes, Dokan Kits is designed to work with any theme that is compatible with Dokan.
